def get_zoneid(restrict, zonename): # 1.机场管制空域 if restrict == "Controlled Airspace": prefix = "D" # 提取三字机场代码 Class D - VNY → VNY code = zonename.split("-")[-1].strip() key = f"{prefix}_{code}" # 2.VIP临时受限空域 elif zonename == "Vip": prefix = "VIP" code = "" key = prefix # 3.Security安全受限空域 elif zonename == "Security": prefix = "SEC" code = "" key = prefix # 4.大型集会 Large Gathering/Public Safety elif "Large Gathering" in zonename: prefix = "GAT" code = "" key = prefix # 5.体育场 Dodger Stadium elif "Stadium" in zonename: prefix = "STA" code = zonename.split()[0] key = f"{prefix}_{code}" # 6.军事基地 Military elif "Military" in zonename: prefix = "MIL" code = zonename.split()[-2] key = f"{prefix}_{code}" # 其余未知类型 else: prefix = "OTH" code = "" key = prefix
# 分组自增流水号 3位补零 if key not in count_dict: count_dict[key] = 1 else: count_dict[key] += 1 seq = f"{count_dict[key]:03d}"
if code != "": return f"{prefix}_{code}{seq}" else: return f"{prefix}{seq}"" TEXT NO_ENFORCE_DOMAINS
